The [Inbox](http://monorepo.localhost/framework/ai/) now runs on [Browse](http://monorepo.localhost/framework/ux/Browse/), one list-and-detail view, with a pinned **Waiting on you** list at the top (114 open decisions today; ticking a line archives its card). It's merged and I checked it on the live site at 1920.

### ✅ Browse `ux/Browse/`
- **The class layout** is on its [Architecture tab](http://monorepo.localhost/framework/ux/Browse/architecture/), and the Browse page itself is a live demo.
- **The structure:** `class Browse` builds the list and detail panes, `Inbox.Rail extends Browse`, and `WaitingOnYou extends Browse.Pinned`.
- **The list:** it takes a third of the screen at 1920 and is wider at 3440, where each row reads like a table row. You can drag its edge to resize it. On a phone the Inbox now opens on the list, not on Live.
- **Built together:** I made the class layout and the build in one go instead of showing the layout before building. Shipping the layout alone would have left nothing to try.
